title: An evaluation of Google Translate for Sanskrit to English translation via sentiment and semantic analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the translation quality disparity of a low-resource, ancient language (Sanskrit) by comparing Google Translate outputs to human expert translations using BERT-based sentiment analysis, MPNet-based semantic similarity (cosine similarity), and n-gram analysis.

Qualitative assessment by a Sanskrit expert to evaluate whether the machine translation system distorts, omits, or misrepresents the contextual, historical, and theological significance of Hindu philosophical concepts (e.g., Advaita Vedanta schools, sacred terms like 'Om' and 'Sat') in the Bhagavad Gita.
